sonnet.problem: The card says the LORD "answers Moses," but verse 10 only says "the LORD said." The text doesn't say this is a reply to Moses' request in verse 9, so the card adds a connection between the two verses.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect. ... Call things what the text calls them. ❌ "Naomi asks the LORD to bless them." ✅ "Naomi tells them, 'May the LORD…'"
